cases.name: Sharon Simmons
cases.narrative:
Police said an argument occurred between Sharon Simmons, 59, and her boyfriend Richard Wayne Becker, 57, while Simmons' friend, 63-year-old Loretta Jones, Simmons' two teenage granddaughters and their 13-year-old friend were inside her home.

Jones told police that something "erupted" between the couple and Becker shot Simmons in her kitchen and then shot Jones two times in the living room.

Jones was able to get out of the house and run to the neighbors across the street, as the three teenagers hid in a bedroom.
